title: Technology Sector Update for 01/30/2019: MKSI,AAPL,MLNX,JNPR
text:

Technology stocks firmed during Wednesday trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were adding over 2.0% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose almost 1.8%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) MKS Instruments ( MKSI ) rose more than 5% after late Tuesday reporting non-GAAP Q4 net income of $1.54 per share, down from $1.71 per share during the yearago period but still beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.03 per share. Revenue for the three months ended Dec. 31 also fell, declining to $461 million from $512 million last year but also exceeded the $441.5 million Street view.
In other sector news:
(+) Apple ( AAPL ) climbed more than 5% on Wednesday after the tech bellwether reported fiscal Q1 net income and revenue exceeding Wall Street expectations, earning $4.18 per share and topping the Capital IQ consensus by $0.01 per share. Revenue fell 5% year-over-year to $84.3 billion, also beating the $84 billion analyst mean.
(+) Mellanox Technologies ( MLNX ) was trading over 7% higher on Wednesday after the Calcalist financial news paper reported Intel ( INTC ) has been courting the Israeli-based chipmaker with an buyout offer worth up to $6 billion in cash and stock.
(-) Juniper Networks ( JNPR ) fell almost 8% after the communications equipment company reported a 4.8% drop in Q4 revenue from year-ago levels, falling to $1.18 billion and missing the analyst consensus by $40 million.
